title: Pro-Communist Publication Entitled The War Flag. Tseu Sien Kyan

Subject (in full) Pro-communist publication entitled "The War Flag" (戰旗報)

Made by D.I.Kuh Pro-hwa Forwarded by （签名）

With reference to the attached letter dated March 15,
1932 from Dr. Tseu Sien Kyeh (周先克), President of the
Shanghai Special District Court, on the subject of a subversive
publication entitled "The War Flag", the editorial offices
of which are reported to be situated in the Pao Zen Lee
(寶善里) off Shantung Road near Pakhoi Road, I have to state
that careful enquiries made by the detectives of this office
in co-operation with the staff of Section 5 fail to produce
any information to show that such a paper has ever existed.
Should such a paper ever have been published in Shanghai,
it must have been surreptitiously disseminated.

Kuh Tao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

March 18, 1932.

Sir,
I have to acknowledge receipt of your letter
No. 3943 of March 15 regarding a publication entitled
"The War Flag" and to inform you that the matter is receiving
attention.
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
(Sp.Br.)
Asst Deputy Commissioner (Chinese).

President,
Shanghai Special District Court.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

（印：SH. C. MUNICIPAL POLICE REGISTRY 3390. 18.3.34.）

Translation of Letter from Shanghai No. 1 Special District Court.

No. 3042    March 15, 1932.

I.M.P. Headquarters,
Shanghai.

Sirs,

At the request of the Bureau of Education in
accordance with an instructional order No. 521 from
the Municipality of Greater Shanghai following a
request made to the latter by the Chekiang Provincial
Government stating that they have discovered a publi-
cation entitled "The War Flag" (戰旗報), its contents
being entirely communistic and instigating labourers
against the Kuomintang on the ground of the present
crisis in Shanghai. The offices of this paper are
situated in the Pau Zeu Li alleyway (寶善里) off
Shantung Road near Pakhoi Road. As this address is
situated within the jurisdiction of the International
Settlement, I have been requested to communicate with
you to take such action as may be deemed necessarily.

Tseu Sien Kyah
President.
